text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day during lunch break. As I was heading to
Calstone Light O's classroom with a message for her...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Just you wait, baguette sandwich!
choice_data_list: Ah, Light O, hold on a sec...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Haaah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I called out to Calstone Light O as she came out of the classroom, but she just ran off...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Excuse me, were you looking for Right O?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Next to emerge from the classroom was Durandal,
a classmate of Calstone Light O and a gallant Umamusume who carried herself like a knight.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"She headed to the school store.
Her target: the limited-quantity 'French Bread Sandwich.'"
choice_data_list: I'll head to the shop. Thanks so much for your kindness.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: No, I merely did what was expected of me.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"I was just heading to the school store myself.
If you don't mind, we could go together."

text_block_list.name: Tracen Academy Student A
text_block_list.text:
Uwooooh, French baguette sandwich!!
I'm definitely getting it!

text_block_list.name: Tracen Academy Student B
text_block_list.text:
Ow! Hey, stop pushing!
That's against school regulations, you know?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The school store was packed with Umamusume looking for lunch.
Whenever there's a limited-edition item, it turns into an outright battlefield.
There was no way a human could possibly squeeze their way in.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
This won't do. As an Umamusume,
one must fight gracefully on any battlefield.
In that regard, Right O-san is truly magnificent.

text_block_list.name: School Store Lady
text_block_list.text: First in line again today with time to spare, huh? You must really love baguette sandwiches.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I love it!
So completely straightforward! How beautiful!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"Calstone-san loves straight things.
Even with that bread, she likes the shape more than the flavor."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Oh, my... Did Believe get a late start, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Following Durandal's gaze,
I spotted Believe among the bustling crowd of Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: She's also a classmate of Calstone Light O. I've heard she's a craftsperson-type Umamusume who takes her time and does things with great care.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Just endure it a little longer... and the person in front of the register will move.
Aim for that moment and step forward...!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
She's handling it well while reading the situation.
However, whether she'll make it in time before
they sell out will be close...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Ah, that girl slipping past everyone up ahead is Believe-san. She's also our classmate—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"...Pardon me, I haven't even introduced myself yet.
My name is Durandal. Right O-san's—"

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: This is my delightful roommate, Durandal!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"Who are you calling amusing!!
You're the absolute last person I want to hear that from!"

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: She's a bit eccentric, but she's a good kid.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: You're the one who's acting strange!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
*Muffled mumbling while chewing*
*Munch munch munch*

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Don't talk with your mouth full!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A sudden comedy routine began to unfold.
Durandal, who had acted like a knight just moments ago,
was now a seasoned straight man.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Jeez... If you're going to eat, let's head to the cafeteria.
I'll eat over there too.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you called for me earlier, right?
Did you need something?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Yes. That is why I called out to you.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
If you could hear me,
shouldn't you have stopped right where you were?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"I was in the middle of the ‘Fastest French Baguette Sandwich Grab Challenge.’
I managed to beat my personal record."
choice_data_list: I had no idea you were taking on a challenge like that...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Oh, is that—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Phew... It was a mad scramble, but I managed to hold out and buy it...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Believe, you managed to buy one too, I see.
A baguette sandwich.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Ah, yes.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
...
Show me what is inside that sandwich.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: "...Huh? Why? No way."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
From the looks of it, the ingredients inside are a mess.
They must have gotten jostled around in the scuffle.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: I shall rearrange those ingredients in a neat line!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: No, thank you. I'm about to eat it already.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Argh, too bad.
That poking tomato, that slipping lettuce...
I really wanted to fix them...!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
There is no need for concern, it is business as usual.
Right O-san simply cannot rest until crooked things are made straight, or so she says.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Once the distortion is out of sight, she'll recover right away.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I couldn't help but admire how unperturbed the two of them were. Getting to know their personalities by chance like this—could you call it a stroke of good fortune?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Believe and Durandal. These two will likely become Calstone Light O's rivals.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Believe's debut has already been set for the same period as Calstone Light O's.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With their distance aptitudes being so similar,
they will undoubtedly clash in the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Durandal's debut hasn't been decided yet,
but her forte is also sprinting and mile races."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I defeated Calstone Light O in the Selection Race.
She is certain to become a fierce rival of mine someday.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It certainly doesn't hurt to know more about them.
If possible, I'd like to learn more details
about their running, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Before that day's training session.

text_block_list.name: Cat Owner
text_block_list.text:
Miiko, wait~! Ah, no!
If you go in there... Geez, come back~!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Whoa, what!? ...A cat?

text_block_list.name: Cat Owner
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me! My child ran onto
the academy grounds...
Could someone please help catch them~!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
U-Um... understood.
Please wait right there.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Quietly, approaching slowly...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Ah, shoot!!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: I have to go after them!

text_block_list.name: Cat Owner
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it got away!
Someone catch that cat~!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Mmh, a cry for help...!?

text_block_list.name: Cat
text_block_list.text: Meow~!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Oh, that cat!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While heading to the track with Calstone Light O,
talking about the matter I forgot to mention at lunch—

text_block_list.name: Cat
text_block_list.text: Meo~w!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
!! Kitty! Trainer, look over there!
It's a kitty! A kitty!!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"So cute, so cute, so cuuute!
Ahhh, kitty! I wanna pet you, huff you, and fluff you!"

text_block_list.name: Cat
text_block_list.text: Meow~? MEOOOWW!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Playing tag, are we?! Ufufu, wait up, wait up~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as she finished rambling, Calstone Light O bolted off at furious speed.
...Full sprint. Far too fast for chasing a cat.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just then, other Umamusume came running toward the cat from a different direction. It was Believe and Durendal.
They, too, seemed to be sprinting at full speed.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Kitty, I'm coming! Haaah!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
If I get too close, it'll run away...
I'll maintain this speed and corner it behind the school building!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Heh... It's not time to make my move yet.
I'll wait for the perfect opening and strike in a flash with my late burst!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Calstone Light O goes full speed from the start.
Believe steadily closes the gap at a constant pace.
Durandal keeps her distance, waiting for the right moment to strike.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Every one of them an equally matchless speedster.
With their three distinct running styles, they corner the cat behind the school building!

text_block_list.name: Right O & Believe
text_block_list.text:
Ooooohhhhh!
Teyaaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Behold the sharpness of my Holy Sword!

text_block_list.name: Cat
text_block_list.text: Eeeek!? M... meooow~...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, the kitty is frightened.
Poor thing. I must calm it down.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The cat stopped in its tracks, curled up against the wall, and began to tremble.
Cornered at high speed by three Umamusume,
one could hardly blame it."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Kuh, cornering the weak like this...
What was I thinking?!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Please don't be afraid. I'm harmless.
Look, see? Unarmed!

text_block_list.name: Cat
text_block_list.text: Eee... meow...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"Don't worry, don't worry. Meow, meow-meow-meow.
Meooww, meow-meow-meow."

text_block_list.name: Cat
text_block_list.text: ...Meoowww.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Slowly letting its guard down, the cat
crept cautiously toward Calstone Light O."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
There, there, there, there. Purr purr, meow.
Ah, so cute... way too cute...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Safely secured. Thank goodness...
I wonder where the owner who was looking for it is.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Ah, I'll be waiting outside the school gates.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Dear kitty, may I pet you? Why yes, I may.
Pet, pet, pet, pet... Hehehehehehe.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Something is off with Calstone Light O.
Holding a cat, she keeps petting it frantically,
showing no sign of letting go.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: "Calstone-san is a huge cat lover, you know. Her dorm room is overflowing with cat merchandise."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
So when it comes to real cats...
I tend to lose my mind a little.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Still, if you fuss over her too much, she might run away again.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: I'll go return this to its owner.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, wait, just a little longer!
Believe! Kitty!!
Come back, Bili-nyanko~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Ngggh... It's so hard to part.
I'm so reluctant to leave that I'm seeing afterimages of cats.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"Right, let's run alongside this afterimage cat.
I feel like I can hit top speed this way."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Yes. We owe it all to the kitty.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I completely agree, all thanks to that cat.
Because of it, we were able to compare
the running styles of Believe and Durandal."
